ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is an insect life cycle schematic diagram, with arrows and letter labels. The letter B is located in the upper right of the image, and beside it is drawn a long, segmented larva crawling on a green leaf. Reasoning: In the life cycle of a butterfly or moth, this kind of segmented larval stage on a leaf is called a caterpillar (caterpillar/larva). Therefore, the letter B depicts a caterpillar.
